verdict.rationale: RudderStack's docs describe official SDKs (e.g., JavaScript SDK) that implement standard event tracking, a dedicated 'standard-events' spec page, and an HTTP/Pixel API for server-side event capture, plus customer testimonials confirming cross-platform analytics collection replacing Segment. missing for 10: explicit doc citations for mobile SDKs (iOS/Android) and server-side SDK docs beyond JS/HTTP API, and independent verification of identify/page implementation fidelity.
